parlays.title: Ladder step 1: 2 legs at FanDuel
parlays.correlation: One leg per game, so the book prices the ticket as the legs multiplied.
parlays.edge: For fun, not value: two easier lines our projections clear comfortably (83% and 88% on our numbers, which are tuned for main lines), at FanDuel's own prices, multiplied to -114. The ladder's whole $50 rides to $94.
parlays.cutoff: A ladder rung is not re-entered. It stands or falls as posted.
parlays.why: Ladder step 1: two easier lines at FanDuel, one per game, each one our projection clears comfortably. The whole $50 rides to $94: a win rolls it into the next step, a miss starts the climb over at $50. Kept apart from the record, in dollars.
parlays.risk: Both legs have to hit; one miss ends the climb. Our player chances are tuned for main lines, so these legs are not value, just the fun of the climb. A player who does not take the field voids his leg under the book's rule, and a person settles the rung.
parlays.entryNote: Closed to new entries at 8:44 AM ET, before its post went out: its Quentin Johnston 25+ receiving yards leg: verified reporting argues against it: Quentin Johnston remains in the Chargers' receiver rotation alongside Tre' Harris and the newly added Marquez Valdes-Scantling, while Ladd McConkey is called the clearest fantasy option at the position. Stays in the record at -114 and is graded as posted.

parlays.title: 3-leg easy props at FanDuel
parlays.correlation: One leg per game, so the book prices the ticket as the legs multiplied.
parlays.edge: For fun, not value: each leg is an easier line our projection clears comfortably (81% or better on our numbers, which are tuned for main lines), priced at FanDuel's own alternate-line price and multiplied to +255. A quarter unit, kept with the longshots.
parlays.cutoff: A fun parlay is not re-entered. It stands or falls as posted.
parlays.why: Easy props, for fun: 3 legs at FanDuel, one per game, each an easier line our projection clears comfortably. A quarter unit, tracked with the longshots, apart from the straight picks.
parlays.risk: Every leg has to hit; one miss sinks the ticket. Our player chances are tuned for main lines, so these legs are not value, just fun. A player who does not take the field voids his leg under the book's rule.
parlays.entryNote: Closed to new entries at 8:44 AM ET, before its post went out: its Elic Ayomanor 10+ receiving yards leg: verified reporting argues against it: Elic Ayomanor played 28 of 53 offensive snaps (52.8%) in Week 2 against the Eagles, which ranked third among Titans wide receivers. Stays in the record at +255 and is graded as posted.
